title: Sula
author: Toni Morrison
summary: Two Black women grow up as close friends in the Bottom, a hillside neighbourhood in Ohio. Their lives split apart when Sula leaves town for years and then returns, upsetting the community's ideas of right and wrong.
readIf: you like compact, lyrical novels about female friendship, community and moral ambiguity.
skipIf: you want a clear plot with tidy resolutions and characters who are easy to like.
